title: M4.5: Discord interactions adapter (deferred, slash commands only)
description:
Deferred until demanded. Interactions endpoint with Ed25519 verification, PING handling, deferred response within 3 seconds and follow-up webhook within 15 minutes; /ask bot message mapped to a pair or guild-thread channel; outbound by bot token REST. Explicitly no Gateway websocket and no message-content intent because the architecture forbids persistent sockets.

Acceptance criteria:
- Only built if the owner opens it; spike decision recorded first
- Bad signature rejected; PING answered
- Slash command round trip with the fake transport

Gherkin: features/discord_interactions.feature

Depends on: M3.2, M2.1

Contract: the External channels contract (initiative description; draft docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md).

Process: Gherkin first (AGENTS.md outside-in). Write the named feature, add it to features/cucumber-features.txt, implement steps in conversation/features-support/steps/, then production code. Vitest only for pure helpers. Both cucumber-js and vitest must pass. No emojis, no compatibility forks, tenant_id on every item, strangers get 404. Product PR into develop with sub-agent review.
